    1. check(T)

Interface FetchMetadataRule<T>

Type Parameters:
T - request type
All Superinterfaces:
io.micronaut.core.order.Ordered
All Known Subinterfaces:
HttpRequestFetchMetadataRule
public interface FetchMetadataRule<T> extends io.micronaut.core.order.Ordered
Evaluates a request using Fetch Metadata or related request information.

Rules are evaluated in order. A rule should return FetchMetadataRuleResult.UNKNOWN when it does not apply so another rule can decide. Custom rules can override Ordered.getOrder() to select their position relative to the built-in policy rules.

Rules run on the request thread, usually a Netty event loop, for every request the filter evaluates. They must be fast and must not perform blocking I/O.

Since:
5.6.0
